item.title: Eagles aim to move up in standings
item.description: An up-be-down week for Boulder City High School boys basketball saw them finish with a 1-2 record in this past week’s slate.

item.title: Council looks ahead at five-year improvement projects
item.description: One of the parts of any city’s annual budget that is of the utmost interest to many of its residents are capital projects. That’s because these projects are things that their citizens can see, use, and appreciate.
